scores.label: A
scores.note: 0s: 4 'more alert to learn', 5 'more focused to learn', 8 'more attentive to learn' are ungrammatical with 'to learn'; 6 'more interested to learn' is unidiomatic and shifts meaning; 9 'more up to speed to learn' is the wrong meaning. 2 willing, 3 eager, 7 motivated drift from readiness to desire; 10 'in the mood' is casual. 'prepared' is the one strong pick.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Only 8 of 10 options. 0s: 4 'more focused to learn' and 5 'more engaged to learn' are ungrammatical with 'to learn'; 6 'thirsty' is an odd figurative choice for the essay; 7 'anxious' adds a sense of worry and changes the meaning. 2 eager, 3 motivated, 8 determined drift toward desire/will but are usable.
